title: Lena and the Salt
author: H. M. Marchetti
blurb: Emrys Dunmore, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
